summary: Build control, liquidity, and reporting skills for mobile money and agency banking operations. Enroll your team for practical, advanced training.
lede: Mobile money and agency banking operations include designing agent networks and managing transactions, liquidity, and controls. The course is for professionals who run, supervise, analyze, or govern these services, and covers agent segmentation, onboarding, and service standards. You will practice float planning, reconciliation and exception tracking, and fraud, KYC, and AML escalation to support reliable, auditable operations.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who run, supervise, analyze, or govern mobile money and agency banking operations and need stronger control over performance, risk, and service quality.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of retail banking, payment operations, or branchless banking; familiarity with agent network processes; and basic exposure to KYC, AML, and transaction reconciliation. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable working with operational reports, spreadsheets, dashboards, and transaction exception logs. Prior experience in mobile money operations, agency banking supervision, payments support, fraud monitoring, or digital channel management will help you move faster through the applied exercises. The advanced sections are taught at operational and implementation-planning depth, not software engineering depth.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
